# Module `pill_spline::component`

Source: `extensions\pill_spline\modules\runtime\src\component.rs:1`

The component, its sampling modes and the mirrored entry points.
The [`Spline`](struct.Spline.md#rustdoc-item-8) component: its control points, its tangents and their maths.

## Responsibilities

- Define the [`Spline`](struct.Spline.md#rustdoc-item-8) component and its fixed-capacity control-point
  arrays, so the type stays plain data across the module boundary.
- Sample a position anywhere along the path in
  [`Spline::get_location_at`](struct.Spline.md#rustdoc-item-0).
- Keep the stored tangents in step with the control points
  ([`Spline::refit_tangents`](struct.Spline.md#rustdoc-item-175)) and report capacity violations with
  [`TooManyControlPoints`](struct.TooManyControlPoints.md#rustdoc-item-10).
- Mirror the sampling entry points managed code calls.
